caption: A new account on 22 Nov 2026 opened on the Free plan with 50 credits and no iStock allowance; the usage page said it resets on 23 Nov.
Our prompt for a 30 second vertical video: InVideo wrote the script and picked free stock clips, then stopped at the voiceover and asked us to upgrade.
After that one attempt the usage page showed 26.4 of 50 credits used, with no voiceover or video made.
The Free plan says to upgrade for all AI models, avatars and watermark free exports; no payment method was on file.
The pricing page on 22 Nov 2026 during the Black Friday sale: Starter €10 and Plus €30 a seat a month billed yearly, Max €62.50 on a two year deal.
